remarks: This inviting 2 bedroom, 1 bathroom unit at The Manor features a spacious living/dining room with two sets of sliding doors that lead to a deck, offering peaceful views of the courtyard and in-ground pool. The unit includes a primary bedroom with a walk-in closet, ample closet space in the second bedroom, and the convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. The kitchen is fully equipped, and the unit has been freshly painted, enhancing its bright and welcoming atmosphere. The Manor is a well-maintained, desirable complex offering a quiet, private environment. Residents enjoy one reserved parking spot, plenty of visitor parking, and easy access to highways, public transportation, and downtown Stamford, with its shops, restaurants, and parks. A credit check, references, and proof of income are required.
